name: zoning-copilot
description: Zoning & Permitting Copilot — React + Express + Groq prototype.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='server/.env';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example',p);console.log('\n  → created server/.env from .env.example — paste your GROQ_API_KEY in there.\n');}"
